title: Surreal Parisian Vision
description: A vibrant watercolor painting of a European cobblestone street lined with colorful shops and trees. In the center floats a large outlined bald male head with rays of pink light emanating from its eyes, while a glowing golden dome radiates above and two figures with umbrellas walk away down the street.
